case_number: 2025 INSC 430; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (Criminal) No. 10931 OF 2022)
summary: Commercial dispute vs criminal cheating; dishonest intention at inception required; mere breach of contract not cheating; representation as creditworthy not deceptive if substantial assets existed; subsequent agreement does not create new inducement; bankers' continued lending supports financial credibility; High Court erred in treating default as fraud; ingredients of Section 415 IPC not satisfied; investigation materials show no deception at outset.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; FIR quashed.
